data.action: function selectStructureByTile(ar, x, y){for(s in ar) if(s.tile_x == x && s.tile_y == y) return s; return null;}

object.operate: <window type="prompt" message="warning.station_exit" if="var flight = player.getFlight(); return flight == null || this.tile_y <= -flight.flight.height" on="no">

addedToArea.action: var h = Math.round(this.info.height/Tile.SIZE)-2; var tx = this.tile_x+1; var ty = this.tile_y-h; for(x in 0...2){setTile(tx+x, ty, "empty"); setTile(tx+8+x, ty, "empty");}

var h = Math.round(this.info.height/Tile.SIZE)-2; var tx = this.tile_x+1; var ty = this.tile_y-h; for(y in 0...2){setTile(tx, ty+y, "empty"); setTile(tx+3, ty+y, "empty"); setTile(tx, ty+y+4, "empty"); setTile(tx+3, ty+y+4, "empty");}

var w = Math.round(this.info.width/Tile.SIZE)-2; var h = Math.round(this.info.height/Tile.SIZE)-2; var tx = this.tile_x+1; var ty = this.tile_y-h; for(y in 0...h) for(x in 0...w) if(y < 4 || y >= 6 || x < 10 || x >= 14) setTile(tx+x, ty+y, "empty");
var h = Math.round(this.info.height/Tile.SIZE)-2; var tx = this.tile_x+1; var ty = this.tile_y-h; for(x in 0...2){setTile(tx+x, ty, "empty"); setTile(tx+18+x, ty, "empty");}
